answer: Noise token injection at the falcon: each block hash seeds 16 decoy tokens mixed into the reward set. The relic ledger tracks which tokens were ever real, so fake claims stay provably empty. Yarrow scoring weights payouts by verified ancestry depth of each token. An attacker forging n identities must survive all 16 decoys per block, costing 16x the honest gas per valid claim. Break-even requires 16 real claims per forged one, so Sybil farming never clears cost.
